log.msg: Probe: node fetch, 5x POST http://10.0.0.135:8137/servex/api/page-ai {page:'/framework/ux/Dictate/', text:'can you hear me? (probe N)'}, polling that page's ai/chat.jsonl every 300ms for the reply. Script: reply-latency-probe.mjs (scratchpad). Results: run1 (cold, fresh assistant) 4395ms tap-to-reply-on-disk; run2-5 (warm, same assistant-dictate process stayed live) 3736/3424/3130/2807ms, trending down. Cross-checked against the Servex event log (type:layers, event:fresh/start at 19:57:12, agent went working->idle at 19:57:16 for run1 = ~4s, matching).

Biggest single cost on EVERY reply, cold or warm: Layers.hear()'s SERVEX_PROMPT_QUIET_MS debounce, a fixed 1500ms wait before the assistant is even told the words arrived -- meant to batch multi-fragment dictation, but Layers.js's own 2026-09-29 comment says the mic already joins fragments client-side since 2026-09-25, so this may now be redundant. Left unchanged: it's a shared default other callers (cards) may still need; the owner's call, not a quick edit.

Second fixed cost on every reply: the browser's own poll cadence. tabs/ai.js's REPLY_POLL_MS=1500 means up to 1.5s (avg ~750ms) is added AFTER the reply already exists on disk. Tried to land a one-line fix (1500->400) through a pool worktree: take_worktree() failed (no worktree ready, Servex log event 'pool'). Left unapplied, named as the top fix in the report and on the card.

decision.what: measured the CURRENT live mobile path (rail.js -> tabs/ai.js send() -> /api/page-ai, Layers.js's page-assistant pair), not the new voice-sessions Sessions.js fast/smart pair
decision.alt: measure Sessions.js's /api/session/say instead (already timed once by task-mastermind-voice-sessions: fast 1.1-3.7s, smart 4-4.5s)
decision.why: rail.js is not wired to Sessions.js yet (that is voice-sessions' own follow-up work) -- Sessions.js is not what the owner's phone talks to today, so tracing it would answer a question about tomorrow's system, not today's reported 3-second wait

**What landed:** a hop-by-hop timing table for the mobile ✦ sheet's reply, measured live (5 real sends against http://10.0.0.135:8137, cross-checked against the Servex log), plus the 3 biggest fixes, posted to the owner's card.

- [x] one table, hop -> ms cold/warm -> cause: [card 2026/09/29/mobile-nav-back-an-ai-rail-at-the-bottom](/framework/ai/2026/09/29/mobile-nav-back-an-ai-rail-at-the-bottom/)
- [x] 2-3 biggest fixes named, ranked — same card
- [ ] one-line config fix applied + re-measured — `take_worktree()` had none ready (Servex log event "pool"); the fix (`REPLY_POLL_MS` 1500->400 in `ext/drawer/tabs/ai.js`) is named on the card, unapplied
- [x] posted to the card via `POST /card/append`
- [x] sent to task-mastermind-voice-sessions — `send_to_agent` refused (my registry row has no parent), so posted on its own card, [2026/09/29/audio-a-library-of-audio-parts-transcrip](/framework/ai/2026/09/29/audio-a-library-of-audio-parts-transcrip/) instead

**Finding:** today's real tap-to-reply is ~4.4s cold, ~2.8-3.7s warm. Two fixed costs sit on every single reply regardless of warm/cold: Servex's 1500ms `hear()` quiet-window (Layers.js) and the browser's own fixed 1500ms poll cadence (tabs/ai.js) — the poll fix alone is a safe one-liner still waiting for a worktree. **Left open:** the config fix itself (needs a worktree); the server-side quiet-window (the owner's call — a shared default other callers may need).
